newsitem.title: MEXICO: Nine dead in Mexico explosion - police.
newsitem.headline: Nine dead in Mexico explosion - police.

text.p: Nine people were killed and dozens injured when an explosion tore through a building in the northern Mexican city of Monterrey, officials said on Monday.

"It's a tragedy. Until now, unofficially, we have nine people dead and at least 20, more like 30, injured," Hector Santos, head of the judicial police in Monterrey, told Mexico's Televisa television network.
An unknown number of people were still trapped in the building and officials were worried it might collapse, Santos said.
"We are closing off a 200-meter (yard) radius around the area because we are told by experts the building could collapse," he said.
The explosion appeared to have been caused by a gas leak in a water heater, he said. Television images showed the blast ripped a large hole through the side of the building.
Santos said all the dead and injured were apparently construction workers.
